updates.title: Mod updates
updates.description: Update checks never run unless you ask: click Check for Updates on the Mods page, or turn on automatic checks here.

auto_check.label: Check for mod updates when DDMM starts
auto_check.description: Off by default. Checks only contact the sites your mods came from, and never download or install anything by themselves.

nexus.title: Nexus Mods API key (optional)
nexus.description: Only used to check Nexus Mods mods for updates. It's never required: without it, everything else works and Nexus mods just aren't checked. DDMM never downloads from Nexus with it; updates still go through your browser.
nexus.where_to_get: Get yours on Nexus Mods: your account → API Keys → the Personal API Key at the bottom (Request/Copy). Paste it here; DDMM checks it with Nexus before saving. Remove it here any time (you can also revoke it on that Nexus page).
nexus.placeholder: Paste your personal Nexus Mods API key

open_page_button.tip: Open the API Keys page of your Nexus Mods account in your browser

nexus.connected_unknown: A Nexus Mods API key is saved.
nexus.stored_keychain: Stored in your system's keychain (credential store), not in DDMM's settings.
nexus.stored_file: No system keychain was available, so the key is stored as a file readable only by you (nexus-api-key in DDMM's data folder).
nexus.privacy: The key is only ever sent to api.nexusmods.com over HTTPS. It isn't written to settings.json or logs, and never goes to the browser extension.
